description: This file implements functions for decrypting media buffers and transforming capabilities in the OpenCDM adapter, including session management and error handling.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt_ex
methods.description: Performs decryption of a media buffer with protection metadata, handling session validation and logging.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt
methods.description: Wrapper around the extended decrypt function, simplifying the call when no caps are provided.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_session_decrypt_buffer
methods.description: Decrypts a buffer using a session, adding protection metadata if possible, with conditional compilation.

methods.name: opencdm_gstreamer_transform_caps
methods.description: Transforms or validates GstCaps, currently a no-op returning success.
